pairs.why: The two saddles are nearly identical in build, stitching, gloss and finish, so neither one is clearly closer to the crisp real cards.
B has visible stitching on the seat and skirt, so it reads more like a built leather object, which matches the lessons; A's leather is plain and a bit rubbery.
B's ground is smoother and cleaner, while A adds dust puffs and gritty texture, and the lessons say the real cards are smoother than that.
A keeps the ground smoother, while B adds a dust cloud and pebble texture, which is the overly textured look the lessons marked down.
